request.body: one keyless tools/call of aws___list_regions, the first of the four prefixed tools this endpoint advertises that no probe record had called, with the empty arguments object its inputSchema declares (properties {}, required []), jsonrpc 2.0, Accept application/json and text/event-stream

decoded.why-this-record-exists: the registry's reviewer refused to let one record claim that all five of this endpoint's tools work keyless when one had been called, and named the condition for the other four: their own measured calls. This is one of those four. It is one request, per the probe schema's own title, "One unauthenticated, unpaid request and what it answered".
decoded.what-it-establishes: aws___list_regions, the name this endpoint's own tools/list advertises, executes for a caller with no credential, no account and no payment, and returns real content rather than a refusal wrapped in a 200. It establishes this for aws___list_regions and for no other tool.
decoded.and-what-it-does-not-establish: nothing about a rate limit: this request was spaced 25 to 26 seconds from its neighbours precisely to avoid the 429 this endpoint answered to a denser sweep on 2026-09-30 (p-20260930-aws-knowledge-mcp-anonymous-429), so the spacing was chosen to dodge a limit, not to measure one. Nothing about the unprefixed-name defect either: the name called here is the prefixed one that works.
decoded.the-status-line-read: the origin's status is the SECOND HTTP line in the captured headers. This container's egress proxy answers CONNECT with its own "HTTP/1.1 200 Connection Established" first; both lines are in the artifact so a reader meets the same trap.

finding: aws___list_regions, called keyless on the AWS Knowledge MCP endpoint with the empty arguments object its own inputSchema declares, answered HTTP 200 with result.isError false and a list of 37 AWS regions with their long names. The tool executes for a caller with no AWS account, no credential and no payment. This record establishes that for aws___list_regions alone; the other four prefixed tools have their own records, because tools/list advertising a name is not the same as the name executing.
